Attack vectors will vary depending on the nature of the executable in question, but would include opening a specially crafted file which was compiled with an affected version of Visual Studio. The specific flaw exists within the compilation of __asm blocks in Visual C++. Incorrect output produced by the compiler can result in a memory corruption condition.
